ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater (MERCURY/Mango Sandstorm) legit RMM agent dropped via spearphish — Atera/ScreenConnect/Syncro install-to-C2
ucs.description: Hunts the MuddyWater/TA450 signature chain where a spearphishing lure (PDF/HTML link or archive) leads a user to install a *legitimate* RMM agent — Atera, ConnectWise ScreenConnect, Syncro, RemoteUtilities, SimpleHelp — which the actor then uses as hands-on-keyboard C2. Pivots on RMM binaries first-seen in the org and spawned by a mail/browser/document/installer parent, which is the tradecraft that distinguishes MuddyWater from IT-sanctioned RMM use.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("AteraAgent.exe","AgentPackageInstaller.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","Syncro.exe","SyncroLive.Agent.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","RemoteUtilities.exe","SimpleService.exe","Remote Workforce Client.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*ScreenConnect*","*AteraAgent*","*RemoteUtilities*","*SimpleHelp*","*ConnectWiseControl*")) AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","explorer.exe","msiexec.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` 
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` 
| eventstats dc(dest) as org_host_count by process_name 
| where org_host_count <= 5 
| sort 0 firstTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let RmmNames = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","agentpackageinstaller.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","syncro.exe","syncrolive.agent.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","remoteutilities.exe","simpleservice.exe","remote workforce client.exe"]);
let RmmTokens = dynamic(["screenconnect","ateraagent","remoteutilities","simplehelp","connectwisecontrol","syncro"]);
// org-wide baseline of where RMM is already common (likely sanctioned IT use)
let CommonRmm = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(60d) .. ago(Lookback))
    | where FileName in~ (RmmNames)
    | summarize Hosts = dcount(DeviceName) by FileName
    | where Hosts > 5
    | project FileName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where FileName in~ (RmmNames) or ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTokens)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","explorer.exe","msiexec.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=leftanti CommonRmm on FileName
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), Total = count(), arg_min(Timestamp, *) by DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, InitiatingProcessFileName
| project FirstSeen, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
let RmmNames = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","agentpackageinstaller.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","syncro.exe","syncrolive.agent.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","remoteutilities.exe","simpleservice.exe"]);
let RmmTokens = dynamic(["screenconnect","ateraagent","remoteutilities","simplehelp","connectwisecontrol","syncro"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ChildName = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| extend ParentName = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ChildName in~ (RmmNames) or CommandLine has_any (RmmTokens)
| where ParentName in~ ("outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","explorer.exe","msiexec.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), Total = count() by Computer, SubjectUserName, ChildName, ParentName, CommandLine
| order by FirstSeen desc

description: Detects a legitimate RMM agent (Atera/ScreenConnect/Syncro/RemoteUtilities/SimpleHelp) launched by a mail, browser, document or scripting-host parent, matching MuddyWater/TA450 install-to-C2 tradecraft.

      - '\Syncro.exe'
      - '\SyncroLive.Agent.exe'
      - '\rutserv.exe'

ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\winword.exe OR *\WINWORD.EXE OR *\excel.exe OR *\EXCEL.EXE OR *\chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\msiexec.exe OR *\powershell.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\cscript.exe) AND (@Image:(*\AteraAgent.exe OR *\ateraagent.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\screenconnect.clientservice.exe OR *\Syncro.exe OR *\rutserv.exe OR *\rfusclient.exe OR *\RemoteUtilities.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*ScreenConnect* OR *screenconnect* OR *AteraAgent* OR *RemoteUtilities* OR *SimpleHelp* OR *ConnectWiseControl*))

ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater PowGoop / POWERSTATS loader — DLL side-load of goopdate.dll driving obfuscated PowerShell from a .dat payload
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater's PowGoop loader, where a legitimately-signed binary side-loads a malicious goopdate.dll that decodes and runs a PowerShell stager reading a paired .dat file, often persisted via scheduled task. Targets the side-load + PowerShell-reading-.dat combination that is distinctive to MuddyWater's POWERSTATS/PowGoop families rather than generic PowerShell abuse.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe") AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("googleupdate.exe","goopdate.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","explorer.exe") AND (Processes.process="*goopdate*" OR Processes.process="*.dat*" OR Processes.process="*Get-Content*" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*-windowstyle hidden*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` 
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` 
| sort 0 firstTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 14d;
// Side-load: malicious goopdate.dll outside the genuine Google\Update path
let SideLoad = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName =~ "goopdate.dll"
    | where FolderPath !has @"\Google\Update\"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, FolderPath, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessId;
// PowerShell loader reading a .dat payload / decoding, characteristic of PowGoop/POWERSTATS
let PsLoader = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("goopdate", ".dat", "Get-Content", "FromBase64String", "-windowstyle hidden", "-w hidden", "IEX", "Invoke-Expression")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("googleupdate.exe","goopdate.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","explorer.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath;
PsLoader
| join kind=leftouter (SideLoad) on DeviceName
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, SideLoadDll = FolderPath
| order by Timestamp desc

SecurityEvent

author: SOC Detection Engineering

tags:

      - '\regsvr32.exe'

    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'

    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'goopdate'
      - '.dat'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'Get-Content'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'

    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-windowstyle hidden'
